question: On the declared closed-FRW V=0 U_plus Darboux momentum base X_plus=R_c times R_{+,p}, does the local Lebesgue half-density convention define a Hilbert representation in which C-hat is the self-adjoint maximal multiplication operator M_c, with an explicit PVM and a distributional zero-fiber pairing on a dense rigged test space?

upstream_results.role: fixes the componentwise canonical pairs (T,c),(Phi,p), the chart image p>0, and the fact that no quantum measure or domain was previously supplied
fixes the local Lebesgue momentum and principal-half-density convention while forbidding transfer of this ordering back through the nonunitary one-term kernel

primary_sources.used_for: the distributional single-constraint rigging and auxiliary-structure boundary
primary_sources.not_used_for: deriving the repository-specific Darboux chart, measure, operator, or physical inner product

representation.maximal_domain: D(C_hat_D)={psi in H_D: c*psi in H_D}
representation.test_space: S_D=S(R_c) completed_tensor S(R_{+,p}), with the half-line factor defined by rapidly decreasing smooth functions and all finite boundary jets allowed

exact_plan: hash-verify both upstream results and their scoped verdicts
verify the Darboux coordinate c is real and the selected base keeps the upstream p>0 component rather than silently doubling it
verify the resolvent multiplier r_z(c)=1/(c-z) satisfies (c-z)r_z=1 and the exact bound |r_z|<=1/|Im z| for Im z nonzero
apply the maximal real multiplication-operator theorem to conclude self-adjointness, spectrum R, and PVM multiplication by indicator functions
verify PVM Boolean algebra and that the singleton spectral projection E({0}) vanishes in Lebesgue L2 although the zero-fiber delta form is nonzero on test functions
keep the zero-fiber form distributional and explicitly separate it from an ordinary bounded projector or a physical inner product
record that no ordering or domain is transferred to the original variables because the prior one-term FIO failed exact finite-hbar unitarity
record that the prior full-p relational Fourier identity is not an identity kernel on the p>0 U_plus component

decision_table.condition: the upstream component and FIO boundary are exact; the maximal real multiplication operator, resolvent, PVM and rigged zero-fiber form are internally consistent
